text: Testing plays a key role in software development. Unit tests check small parts of code, like individual functions. Integration tests make sure different parts work together correctly. Many developers use test-driven development, where they write tests before the actual code. This approach helps them think clearly about what the code should do. Tests also give developers confidence. When changes are made, tests quickly show if something breaks. Without tests, teams often feel afraid to improve their code. With good tests, they can refactor and add new features more safely. In short, testing saves time, reduces stress, and helps teams build better software.
